briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Momentum Building: Michigan Eyes Tax Relief as National Rescheduling and Psychedelics Wins Pile Up
briefs.top: Michigan operators have real reasons for optimism this week — a $17 billion sales milestone, a GOP repeal push on the 24% wholesale tax, and a court win for a Jars Cannabis store — even as regulators flex enforcement muscle. Nationally, Alabama dropped its rescheduling opposition, a federal court upheld medical marijuana's Schedule III move, and Compass Pathways keeps its psilocybin NDA on track for a potential 2027 launch.
